title: Lima by night including Catacombs & Water Show Tour
overview: Discover the Peruvian capital from an alternative vantage point on a small-group nighttime tour. Begin by exploring the eerie catacombs beneath the San Francisco Monastery, which house the remains of over 70,000 individuals. Then, stroll around the city's historic center, and listen to insightful and engaging commentary from your guide. As night falls, soak in the enchanting ambiance of Lima's illuminated landmarks.

overview: The Marcahuasi stone forest is often overlooked by visitors, but this mystical site shouldn't be missed by anyone with an interest in nature or history—and this private guided tour from Lima will show you why. Discover monolithic stone forms, unobstructed vista points, and tucked-away attractions far from any crowds as you explore off the beaten path and delve into Peruvian lore.

title: Explore Lima On Bike: Coast Cycling Adventure
overview: Climb aboard your modern bicycle and begin your experience, stopping at impressive war memorials and significant historical landmarks as your guide offers insight into Lima’s colorful past. First stop to revitalize will be the charming seaside neighborhood of Chorillos where it is possible to admire outstanding views of the Pacific Ocean before riding into the bohemian barrio of Barranco, an artistic enclave in which musicians, writers and artists reign supreme.
